works.label: 01 / Define the task
works.summary: Turn one task into a clear brief with inputs, boundaries, a finish line, and checks. The builder runs in your browser without an account or a connected AI service.

image.alt: Example task brief with purpose, supplied material, deliverable, checks, and boundaries.
image.caption: Actual builder output from the existing fictional writing example. Result excerpt; no AI answer is generated.

works.label: 02 / Count the whole job
works.summary: Compare the time you spend on the entire workflow, including preparation, review, repairs, setup, and upkeep. See both savings and losses, with the assumptions visible.

image.alt: Fictional calculator example: 180 minutes usual time versus 165 minutes including setup, review, and upkeep.
image.caption: Actual calculator result excerpt for a fictional planning example. The 15-minute saving is illustrative, not a measured personal outcome.

works.label: 03 / Inspect a real release
works.summary: An AI-assisted website change passed 347 unit tests, but a different check found malformed HTML. Follow the failure, repair, and independently checkable release record.
